## 1. 测试环境 / Tested environment

本教程在 Ubuntu 18.04 上使用 DIA-NN 2.2.0（学术版）测试。

This tutorial was tested on Ubuntu 18.04 with DIA-NN 2.2.0 (academic).

## 2. 准备：下载 DIA-NN 安装包 / Preparation: Download the DIA-NN Installation Package

### 2.1 下载并解压 DIA-NN / Download and unzip DIA-NN

官方仓库是 <https://github.com/vdemichev/DiaNN>，发布页是 <https://github.com/vdemichev/DiaNN/releases>。从 GitHub 下载官方学术版：

The official repository is <https://github.com/vdemichev/DiaNN>, and the releases page is <https://github.com/vdemichev/DiaNN/releases>. Download the official academic release from GitHub:

```bash
wget https://github.com/vdemichev/DiaNN/releases/download/2.0/DIA-NN-2.2.0-Academia-Linux.zip -O DIA-NN-2.2.0-Academia-Linux.zip
unzip DIA-NN-2.2.0-Academia-Linux.zip -d diann-2.2.0
```

解压后会得到一个名为 `diann-2.2.0` 的文件夹，里面有可执行文件 `diann-linux` 以及它依赖的库。

This will unzip a folder named `diann-2.2.0`, which contains the executable `diann-linux` and its dependencies.

### 2.2 确认已安装 Docker / Make sure Docker was installed

官方教程见 <https://docs.docker.com/engine/install/ubuntu/>，建议用 APT 安装。

The official tutorial is at <https://docs.docker.com/engine/install/ubuntu/>. It is suggested to install via APT.

```bash
# Add Docker's official GPG key:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install ca-certificates curl
sudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings
sudo curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg -o /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc
sudo chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc

# Add the repository to Apt sources:
echo \
  "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/docker.asc] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu \
  $(. /etc/os-release && echo "${UBUNTU_CODENAME:-$VERSION_CODENAME}") stable" | \
  sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/docker.list > /dev/null
sudo apt-get update

# Install required packages
sudo apt-get install docker-ce docker-ce-cli containerd.io docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin

# Check if docker works
sudo docker run hello-world
# It will print a message.
```

最后一条命令会打印一条消息，说明 Docker 已经可用。

It will print a message.

## 3. 编写 Dockerfile / Write the Dockerfile

在 `diann-2.2.0` 的父目录中新建一个 `Dockerfile`，内容如下：

Create a `Dockerfile` in the parent directory of `diann-2.2.0` with the following content:

```dockerfile
FROM ubuntu:latest

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

RUN apt-get update && apt-get upgrade -y && \
    apt-get install -y libgomp1 locales wget unzip curl apt-transport-https && \
    locale-gen en_US.UTF-8 && update-locale LANG=en_US.UTF-8

ENV LANG=en_US.UTF-8
ENV LANGUAGE=en_US:en
ENV LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8

# Install .NET Runtime 8.0
RUN wget https://packages.microsoft.com/config/debian/12/packages-microsoft-prod.deb -O packages-microsoft-prod.deb && \
    dpkg -i packages-microsoft-prod.deb && \
    apt update && \
    apt install -y dotnet-sdk-8.0 aspnetcore-runtime-8.0 dotnet-runtime-8.0 && \
    apt update && \
    apt upgrade -y

# Copy the locally extracted DIA-NN folder into the image
COPY diann-2.2.0 /opt/diann-2.2.0

WORKDIR /opt/diann-2.2.0

RUN chmod -R 775 /opt/diann-2.2.0

CMD ["./diann-linux", "-v"]
```

## 4. 构建镜像 / Build the Docker Image

进入存放 `Dockerfile` 的目录，执行：

Navigate to the directory containing the `Dockerfile` and run:

```bash
docker build -t diann-2.2.0-dotnet .
```

## 5. 验证版本 / Run the Image to Check Version (Test)

运行下面的命令，确认镜像可以正常工作：

Run this command to verify the image is working:

```bash
docker run --rm diann-2.2.0-dotnet
```

如果看到 DIA-NN 的版本信息，说明镜像构建成功。

If you see the DIA-NN version information, the image was built successfully.

## 6. 一个真实的 DIA 分析任务 / Example: Running an Actual Analysis Task

先准备输出目录，例如：

First, prepare the output directory, like:

```bash
mkdir -p /mnt/ms_data/txt
```

然后挂载原始数据文件，带上必要参数运行 DIA-NN：

Then run DIA-NN with your raw data files mounted and necessary parameters:

可用的参数见命令行参考：<https://github.com/vdemichev/DiaNN?tab=readme-ov-file#command-line-reference>。

Check the available parameters: <https://github.com/vdemichev/DiaNN?tab=readme-ov-file#command-line-reference>.

实际运行时可以用：

Then it could be run with:

```bash
docker run --rm \
  -v /mnt/ms_data:/data \
  diann-2.2.0-dotnet \
  ./diann-linux \
  --f "/data/Ref10812_S1_20250704.raw" \
  --f "/data/Ref10812_S2_20250704.raw" \
  --f "/data/Ref10812_S3_20250704.raw" \
  --lib "" \
  --threads 48 \
  --verbose 3 \
  --out "/data/txt/report.parquet" \
  --qvalue 0.01 \
  --matrices \
  --out-lib "/data/txt/report-lib.parquet" \
  --gen-spec-lib \
  --predictor \
  --prosit \
  --fasta "/data/Hybird.AllSamples.IsoQuant.TD2.fasta" \
  --fasta-search \
  --min-fr-mz 200 \
  --max-fr-mz 1800 \
  --met-excision \
  --min-pep-len 7 \
  --max-pep-len 30 \
  --min-pr-mz 300 \
  --max-pr-mz 1800 \
  --min-pr-charge 1 \
  --max-pr-charge 4 \
  --cut K*,R* \
  --missed-cleavages 1 \
  --unimod4 \
  --no-prot-inf \
  --reanalyse \
  --rt-profiling \
  --no-norm
```

## 7. 先在 Windows 上试参数 / Windows Example Command

如果不确定参数怎么写，可以先把整套流程在 Windows 上跑通，拿到命令行参数，再复制到 Linux。

If we are not sure about the parameters, we could set up everything and run on Windows to get the command line parameters, then copy them to Linux.

在 Windows 上可以类似地运行 DIA-NN，只需调整路径与参数：

From Windows, you can run DIA-NN similarly (adjusting paths and parameters):

```bash
diann.exe --f "H:\MS_data\Ref10812_20250704\Ref10812_S1_20250704.raw" \
--f "H:\MS_data\Ref10812_20250704\Ref10812_S2_20250704.raw" \
--f "H:\MS_data\Ref10812_20250704\Ref10812_S3_20250704.raw" \
--lib "" --threads 8 --verbose 3 --out "C:\Temp\report.parquet" \
--qvalue 0.01 --matrices --out-lib "C:\Temp\report-lib.parquet" --gen-spec-lib --predictor --prosit \
--fasta "Y:\MS_data\Hybrid_protein_sequences\Hybird.AllSamples.IsoQuant.TD2.fasta" --fasta-search \
--min-fr-mz 200 --max-fr-mz 1800 --met-excision --min-pep-len 7 --max-pep-len 30 \
--min-pr-mz 300 --max-pr-mz 1800 --min-pr-charge 1 --max-pr-charge 4 --cut K*,R* --missed-cleavages 1 \
--unimod4 --no-prot-inf --reanalyse --rt-profiling
```

## 译注 / Translator's note

原文的 Windows 命令沿用 `\` 作为续行符，这是为了与 Linux 部分保持一致的排版。若在 Windows 的 `cmd` 中执行，续行符是 `^`；在 PowerShell 中是反引号；也可以直接写成一行。这里按原文保留，未做改写。

The original Windows command uses `\` for line continuation to match the Linux block. In Windows `cmd` the continuation character is `^`, and in PowerShell it is a backtick; alternatively write the command on one line. It is reproduced verbatim here.
:::
